name: Visions
text: When you gain this card, place it face up in your play area. While this card is in your play area, your ships' movement is not affected by nebulae. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Dreaming Throne player's units, return this card to the Dreaming Throne player.

name: Fracture
text: After 1 of your non-fighter ships in the active system is destroyed during combat against a player other than the Crystellum player: Place a number of fighters up to the cost of the destroyed ship in that unit's system. Then, return this card to the Crystellum player.

name: From the Ashes
text: During a combat against a player that is not the Ashen Legion player: When 1 of your units would be destroyed during ground combat, it is not destroyed instead. Then, return this card to the Ashen Legion player. The Ashen Legion player captures 1 infantry from the supply.

name: Ejection
text: During a combat against a player other than the Iron Tide player: When one of your mechs is destroyed, you may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet. If you do, return this card to the Iron Tide player.

name: Advanced Structural Engineering
text: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control. This planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its resource value as if it were a unit. PRODUCTION X.

name: Shared Network Access
text: When you research a non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology: You may place this card face up in your play area to ignore 1 prerequisite on that technology. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Net-Runners player.

name: Disciple
text: ACTION: Place an ingress token in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships. Then, purge this card.
